purpose: Supplement the occluded fn19-v1 local views with declared anatomy diagnostics; never replace or relabel v1 captures.
population: All twelve original mature fn19-v1 specimens, exact original parameters and generated array hashes
target_selection: Reuse v1 normalized semantic target and deterministic tie ordering. Targets and source arrays never change. Per-case camera/depth conditions are visually admitted for anatomy visibility and frozen in admissions.json.
wood: Original wood arrays retained unchanged. Exact admitted near/far planes may crop remote context or retain full depth; named attachment and local incoming connectivity are admitted by direct inspection. Every depth-cut end is a crop boundary, not cap anatomy.
fork_foliage: All foliage suppressed to expose the woody junction.
shoot_foliage: Retain original complete element prototypes and transforms whose origins map to the selected terminal segment under the v1 tapered-segment attachment rule. Suppress unrelated foliage. Record every original instance index. Attachment ownership is geometric inference because the generator exposes no owner ID.
camera: Automatic proposals use 48 fixed directions and local anatomy framing with a 1.35 margin. Strict lateral radial-facing/local-radius probes, projected retained organ area and foreshortening rank proposals; they do not establish anatomical visibility. Direct implementation-side inspection admits exact per-case conditions, including widened depth and an original-geometry-verified historical uncropped camera. Fixed capture reuses these exact cameras, targets and retained instance indices without search/refit. Final actual images require inspection.
visibility_gate: The admission file must contain the exact twelve mature cases and both named views, an actual inspected preview with verified SHA256, observation and exact conditions. Automatic probe failure remains explicitly unassessed; it does not override direct visual admission. Every final 128-sample image requires direct inspection. Hidden surfaces remain unassessed.
supersedes: v2/v2.1 proposals: back-side collars or remote wood overlap prevented assessment; old attempts retained
replay: This runner replays original baseline arrays only: changed source/geometry is rejected. Future candidate comparison requires explicit semantic mapping and the same admitted camera/depth/filter conditions; no silent search or refit.
